title: Chapter 12: Contemplation
paragraphs: After a year of hard work, Chen Mobai's parents barely earned around 50,000 Merit Points.
But now, these two Spirit Stones in his hands were equivalent to half a year's worth of their income.
No wonder he momentarily lost his composure.
In truth, Chen Mobai had never actually touched a Spirit Stone in his life. Had it not been for the detailed descriptions in textbooks and holographic dramas, he might not even have recognized them.
It was at that moment that Chen Mobai realized this Water Abode might no longer be within the territory controlled by the Immortal Sect.

Forcing himself to steady his trembling hands, he carefully placed the Spirit Stones on his clothes, then pulled out his phone and photographed the first thirty pages ofDetailed Explanation of the Azure Water Formation.
Chen Mobai feared he might not be able to bring these treasures back to the city. By photographing the book with his phone, he could at least study the knowledge at school later.
Tying up his clothes into a bundle and cradling it in his arms, Chen Mobai opened the "Turtle Gem" app on his phone and pressed the Recall button.
A silvery-white light flashed briefly, and when Chen Mobai opened his eyes, he found himself sitting on his bed.
He glanced at the clock on the wall—it was exactly half an hour before class started.
The heavy weight in his hands only intensified his excitement.
I got it all back!

He opened the clothes and laid the items one by one on the floor. After recounting and confirming everything, Chen Mobai couldn't contain his excitement any longer. He leaped onto the bed and did a somersault.
Fortunately, the house had been built with soundproof Restrictions. Otherwise, the commotion would have surely woken his parents.
After venting his excitement, Chen Mobai opened his wardrobe and stashed the Spirit Stones, Hand Crossbow, and Dagger deep inside, burying them beneath other items to avoid suspicion.
Then he retrieved his long-unused backpack and packed the Metal and the books inside.
Finally, only the Needle Case used by the brown-robed youth remained.
Chen Mobai hesitated. This was undoubtedly a genuine Magic Tool, though he couldn't determine its tier.
Since he didn't know how to use it, the best approach seemed to be selling it online.
However, secondhand Magic Tool transactions on the Immortal Sect Network required authentication certificates.
Cultivation items, especially Magic Tools, were overwhelmingly secondhand—over eighty percent, in fact.

To maintain order in the Magic Tool trading market, the Immortal Sect issued certificates to cultivators who passed the Artifact Appraisal Qualification Exam. Regulations stipulated that every Magic Tool transaction required an appraisal certificate issued by an Artifact Appraiser.
Each transaction necessitated a fresh appraisal to determine the tool's wear and tear, remaining lifespan, and other factors.
Of course, official regulations were one thing, while actual trading practices were another.

This was especially true for First-Tier Magic Tools. Some Low-Grade items were worth less than the travel expenses of hiring an Artifact Appraiser, leading to the continued circulation of unlicensed products on the market.
However, for a Magic Tool to fetch a good price, appraisal was an indispensable step.
This was particularly critical for Second-Tier Magic Tools and above. Due to their immense value, cultivators generally only dared to purchase them after an Artifact Appraiser had inspected them.
Consequently, the profession of Artifact Appraiser ranked among the most popular certified trades within the hundred arts of immortal cultivation.

Having purchased three Azure Arrow Talismans, Chen Mobai was now penniless, lacking even the Merit Points needed to hire a certified Artifact Appraiser. He had no choice but to set aside the Needle Case for later, either until he had funds for appraisal or until he could figure out how to use it himself.
Despite his thoughts, Chen Mobai still slipped the Needle Case into his backpack and took it to school.
This was the first true Magic Tool he had ever owned.

Slinging his backpack, now brimming with newfound wealth, over his shoulder, Chen Mobai went downstairs, tossed the fish into the sink, heated up two cornbread buns for breakfast, and headed straight to school.
It so happened that today was Teacher Chan's turn to teach the Formation Arts class.
Teacher Chan, a young and still-practicing instructor, was rumored to be an active cultivator at Dan Zhu Academy.
Although she was the least experienced instructor at Immortal Sect Fifth High School, Chen Mobai felt her teaching was among the best—or at least one of the best.
He wouldn't have added that qualifier if the school hadn't also had a Foundation Establishment Stage principal teaching classes.

Perhaps because of her youth, Teacher Chan's thinking resonated with the students' mindset. At least, her explanations of formations were always clear and thorough, and her examples were vivid and memorable.
Precisely for this reason, even though Chen Mobai rarely paid much attention to the Formation Arts course, he could still firmly recall nearly everything Teacher Chan had taught.
Thanks to this, Chen Mobai had been able to repair and reactivate the Azure Water Grand Formation.

Teacher Chan possessed attractive features and a good figure, but she rarely smiled and maintained a serious demeanor during lectures. Had she been more approachable, her popularity would have soared even higher.
Among cultivators, ugliness was virtually nonexistent.

After all, generations of cultivating immortality had naturally refined their bodies toward perfection. While Spiritual Roots were a matter of fate, beyond human control, acquiring a handsome appearance required merely a few years of dedicated Qi Refinement.

Some cultivators, to prove their unwavering devotion to the path of immortality, would even undergo cosmetic surgery to intentionally disfigure themselves, demonstrating that they harbored no worldly desires beyond their pursuit of the Dao.
Chen Mobai had an uncle from his clan who, as a young man, possessed unparalleled beauty. A video of him selling wares on the street went viral overnight, turning him into an internet sensation.

Yet his resolve to cultivate immortality remained unshaken. Faced with countless offers from film and television companies, he had his features surgically altered to become utterly ordinary and unremarkable.

Despite possessing only average Spiritual Root aptitude, he still gained admission to Lingshu Academy, one of The Hundred and Twenty Academies. Now, he spends his days immersed in the earth's geomantic veins, excavating the relics of ancient cultivators for preservation and research.
The morning's formation class passed quickly as Chen Mobai focused intently on studying theDetailed Explanation of the Azure Water Formation.
After class, he repeated his earlier tactic, pretending to lag behind a step before slipping into Teacher Chan's office.

He used the same excuse as before, claiming his parents had hired a private tutor to help him prepare for the college entrance exams. He explained that he had been assigned several homework problems related to the renovation and maintenance of formations, which he needed to solve independently. However, the student confessed to being hopelessly dense, unable to solve the problems despite his best efforts, and had no choice but to seek guidance from the teacher.
Unlike Old Man Ding, Chan Si listened to Chen Mobai's explanation and then examined the Azure Water Formation's rank written on the draft paper, her brow furrowing slightly.
"Given your skill level, would a private tutor dare to assign you homework on a second-tier formation?"
"It's just about restarting the formation after renovation and maintenance," Chen Mobai insisted, forcing an explanation. "The tutor has already taught me the fundamentals of the entire formation."
Chan Si glanced at him with a meaningful smile, but said nothing more. She picked up her pen, ready to demonstrate her mastery as a teacher by solving all the problems on the draft paper.
But after reviewing them thoroughly, she realized that even with her extensive knowledge, she had no idea where to begin.
"Hmm, the formation principles taught by your tutor seem to contradict the mainstream methods of the Immortal Sect. They're practically two entirely different systems."
